payload.title: Cleanup: drop the fallbacks, the #1361 filter and the old stage index
payload.description: After all seven sites have run the backfill and read the new index for two weeks with zero verify drift: remove the CLI fallback and capability check, the console versionState filter, and (separate deploy, the only GSI change in it) the old index stage/updatedAt (listItemsByStageAndUpdatedAt), which stops copying every version of every story into a second index. A repository test fails if anything still names listItemsByStageAndUpdatedAt or itemsByStage. Deploys: 1 backend deploy per site, Ryan's approval. Acceptance: grep test green; verify dry run zero changes on all seven sites before and after.
